nameOfQualification: Jute Machine Maintenance Technician (Elective 1- Spinning machinery, Elective 2- Weaving Machinery)
description: Jute Machine Maintenance Technician plays a very important role in:The operation of Jute mill machineries used in jute mill and its maintenance requirements. Inspecting, repairing and maintaining the machinery and equipment used in the jute millIdentifying and diagnosing equipment malfunctions and technical issues Elucidate various components of power transmission system present in Jute mill machinery Identify the standard maintenance schedule Carrying out repairs on damaged or faulty machinery components, such as motors, belts, bearings and other mechanical parts. Identify electrical circuits, electronic components and techniques used for Jute Machinery and trouble shooting Measure various statistical quality parameters in jute mill maintenance and store record keeping using spread sheet or App.
